newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: S&P raises Norwich NZ units claims-paying ratings.
newsitem.headline: S&P raises Norwich NZ units claims-paying ratings.

text.p: Ratings agency Standard & Poor's said on Friday it had raised its claims-paying ability ratings on State Insurance Limited and Norwich Union Life Insurance (NZ) Limited to AA and AA- respectively.

Both are units of the recently floated UK-based Norwich Union group and the upgrades reflect what S&P called the group's "significantly improved capitalisation and excellent financial flexibility following flotation".
The parent's main operating company was assigned an AA claims-paying rating when the group was floated.
